kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Relative noun (nisba) composed of مَا هِيَ (mā hiya, “what is it”) + ـِيَّة (-iyya), a calque of Ancient Greek τὸ τί ἦν εἶναι (tò tí ên eînai) used by Aristotle. Compare هُوِيّة (huwiyya).

Arabic ماهية
Ultimately from Persian ماه (mâh, “moon; month”).
From the root م ه و (m h w) related to extending or formally more likely the same Persian origin as above by reason of having a lunate shape.
